table.caption: What each side gets for each way a cricket match can end, by format.
rows: A tie, settled by a super over

text: Each row is a real cricket match played to that ending: Ana beats Ben, and Cy and Dev finish level, are rained off or are abandoned.
A win, T20: Ana beat Ben 61/9 (20) — 35 (5).
A tie, T20: Cy and Dev tied 113/9 (20) — 113/7 (20).
A tie, settled by a super over, T20, super over on: Ana beat Ben in a super over 113/9 (20) — 113/7 (20) · SO 10–8.
Abandoned, with no result, T20: Cy and Dev abandoned, no result, 151/5 (19.1) — 70/3 (6.5).
A win, Test match: Ana beat Ben 158/0 & 4/7 — 3/7 & 17/9.
A draw, Test match: Cy and Dev drew 42 & 105/6d — 61/2.
A tie, Test match: Cy and Dev tied 42 & 33/4 — 20/7 & 55/4.
Abandoned, Test match: Cy and Dev abandoned, booked as a draw, 134/9 & 179/1d — 73/8d & 151/8.
